description: This file contains functions and configuration scripts for managing wireless interfaces using the mac80211 driver in a networking environment. It includes initialization, configuration, and setup routines for wireless interfaces, access points, stations, mesh networks, and monitoring modes, along with handling capabilities and device-specific parameters.

methods.name: wdev_tool
methods.description: Runs a ucode script related to wireless device operations.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Calls a specified ubus method with locking for exclusive access.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_device_config
methods.description: Initializes device-level configuration parameters for mac80211.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_init_iface_config
methods.description: Initializes interface-level configuration parameters for mac80211.

methods.name: mac80211_add_capabilities
methods.description: Adds capabilities flags to a variable based on matching criteria.

methods.name: mac80211_add_he_capabilities
methods.description: Adds High Efficiency (HE) capabilities flags based on cert.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_base
methods.description: Sets up the base configuration for hostapd for a given physical interface.

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_bss
methods.description: Configures a BSS (Basic Service Set) interface for hostapd.

methods.name: mac80211_get_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address for a given interface index.

methods.name: mac80211_generate_mac
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a device based on index and base.

methods.name: get_board_phy_name
methods.description: Determines the physical interface name from board JSON data.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_path
methods.description: Renames physical interface based on path info.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_name
methods.description: Renames physical interface based on its current name.

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Finds a PHY by various identifiers and renames if necessary.

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Detected if an access point is active on the interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_ifname
methods.description: Sets interface name based on prefix and type.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares a virtual interface with configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_iw_htmode
methods.description: Prepares wireless HT/VHT/HE mode settings.

methods.name: mac80211_add_mesh_params
methods.description: Adds mesh-specific parameters to the configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_adhoc
methods.description: Sets up an adhoc mode Wi-Fi interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_mesh
methods.description: Sets up a mesh mode Wi-Fi interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_monitor
methods.description: Sets up a monitor mode Wi-Fi interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_vif_txpower
methods.description: Sets transmission power for a virtual interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration for wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_interface
methods.description: Adds a network interface to wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration for wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: hostapd_set_config
methods.description: Configures hostapd with the given PHY and radio parameters.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_start
methods.description: Starts wpa_supplicant on a given PHY and radio.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_supplicant
methods.description: Configures and initializes wpa_supplicant for a virtual interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_vif
methods.description: Sets up a specific virtual interface with appropriate drivers and configs.

methods.name: get_freq
methods.description: Gets the frequency (MHz) for a given channel and band.

methods.name: chan_is_dfs
methods.description: Checks if a channel requires DFS (radar detection).

methods.name: mac80211_set_noscan
methods.description: Disables scanning operations.

methods.name: mac80211_reset_config
methods.description: Resets the device configuration to defaults.

methods.name: mac80211_set_suffix
methods.description: Sets suffixes for PHY and VIF names based on radio.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_setup
methods.description: Main driver function to setup a mac80211 device based on config JSON.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up and resets configuration of a mac80211 device.
